'''Serpent Meat''' is a guaranteed drop from [[Serpent]]s, and drops in quantities of 6-7. It can be cooked on an [[Iron Cooking Station]] to obtain '''Cooked Serpent Meat''' and be eaten or crafted into other foods. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Serpent|0star=6-7|px=70}} |stars=0}} == Usage == === Crafting === ==== For Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Cooked Serpent Meat|nolink=1}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long ==== For Cooked Serpent Meat ==== * {{Item link|Serpent Stew}} * {{Item link|Sailor's Bounty}} Unlike most other foods made from meat, Serpent Meat has to be cooked on an Iron cooking station first to be crafted into other foods. == Notes == * Serpent Meat floats. It can remain floating for a considerable period. If the player kills a Serpent during a storm but cannot pick up the meat at the time, return as soon as possible and the meat may still be recoverable. * As [[Serpent Stew]] provides more health and stamina, eating the meat is not ideal unless in excess of it. * The stew's constituent ingredients are easily obtainable, with [[Mushroom]]s able to be foraged from [[Meadows]] and [[Black Forest]]s, while the [[Honey]] can be obtained from [[Beehive]]s. * A player eating Cooked Serpent Meat may want to limit the amount of it they carry, as each one is much heavier than any other foods. {{FoodsNav}} [[ru:Мясо змея]] [[cs:Maso z hada]]

{{infobox item | title = Barley | image = Barley.png | description = A bundle of barley. | id = Barley | type = Seed | source = [[Fuling Village]]s in the [[Plains]] biome.
[[Abandoned Village]] [[Barrel]]s. | usage = Building, Crafting, Farming, Taming | weight = 0.2 | stack = 100 | teleport = Yes | crop = 2 Barley | grow time = {{duration|4000}}-{{duration|5000}} | cultivated = Yes | radius = 0.5 | biomes = [[Plains]] }} '''Barley''' is a material item found in the [[Plains]] biome, in [[Fuling Village]]s as small patches of cultivated land, and inside of [[Loot chest#Plains Chest|Plains Chest]] found in Fuling Villages, [[Fuling Outpost]]s and [[Fuling Ruin]]s, as well as the barrels inside the granary of [[Abandoned Village]]s in the [[Deep North]]. Barley can only be planted and harvested in the [[Plains]] biome, using a [[Cultivator]]. It takes between 4,000 seconds and 5,000 seconds (between 66 minutes 40 seconds and 83 minutes 20 seconds, or about 2.22-2.78 in-game days) for it to fully grow. Fully grown Barley will drop two Barley when damaged by weapons. AoE attacks, such as those of the [[Stagbreaker]], [[Iron Sledge]] or [[Polearms|Polearms']] secondary attack can be used. No Barley is lost, however, these methods do not grant experience towards the [[Farming (Skill)|Farming skill]], and the chance of extra yields will not trigger. As such, using a [[Scythe]] or harvesting by hand have potentially better yield. ==Usage== ===Building=== *{{Item link|Straw}} ===Crafting=== *{{Item link|Barley Flour}} via {{Item link|Windmill}} *{{Item link|Barley Wine Base: Fire Resistance}} *{{Item link|Yggdrasil Porridge}} ===Farming=== *2 Barley can be obtained by planting and growing a single Barley using the [[Cultivator]]. ===Taming=== *{{Item link|Lox|size=64px}} *{{Item link|Hen|size=40px}} {{MaterialsNav}} [[Category:Materials]] [[fr:Orge]] [[cs:Ječmen]] [[ru:Ячмень]] [[de:Gerste]] [[uk:Ячмінь]]

'''Jotun puffs''' are crops which grow in the [[Mistlands]]. They can be found naturally in the biome and farmed by planting them using a [[Cultivator]].

== Availability ==
* Jotun puffs can be gathered in the [[Mistlands]].
* Using a [[Cultivator]], they can be planted in cultivated soil in the same biome, which is the only place they will grow. Like [[Flax]] and [[Barley]], it is planted directly, rather than needing to farm seeds first. One planting will yield three Jotun puffs.

== Usage ==
* Can be replanted to produce more Jotun puffs using a [[Cultivator]] within the Mistlands.
* Can be eaten directly, but the Health and Stamina provided are far inferior to other foods available in its tier.
* Be careful where you plant these, as the giant rocks in the Mistlands can block out the sky, which prevents them from growing. 
=== Crafting ===
* {{item link|Misthare Supreme}}
* {{item link|Honey Glazed Chicken}}
* {{item link|Mushroom Omelette}}
* {{item link|Salad}}
* {{item link|Mead Base: Lingering Stamina}}
* {{item link|Mead Base: Minor Eitr}}
* {{item link|Scorching Medley}}

== Notes ==
* In real life, puffballs are mushrooms with characteristic ball-shaped tops that burst to spread their spores.
* In response to above, as everything in the Mistlands is scaled up in size proportionately, it is easier to assume that Jotun puffs are actually a type of slime mold, based off of their shape and size in relation to the environment. <!--Should be verified with someone that knows slime molds I guess.-->
